partner_result.used_fact: orthonormal ORIGINAL-leaf frame (r,y) with max row leverage <1/54 and physical star C=sqrt(h)gamma r with ||C||^2>16065/16384
partner_result.application: rank-one transverse residuals with |lambda|>=1 satisfy density <7.610

new_theorem.statement: For one ORIGINAL hub H, orthonormal leaf coefficient vectors x,y with max_i(x_i^2+y_i^2)<=1/2, Q=alpha H^2+2sHL+bL^2+2kLV+dV^2+affine, if the leaf 2x2 block has rank one and the aggregate 3x3 matrix M has all three eigenvalue moduli >=1, then ||p_Q||_infinity <=3*2^(4/3)|det M|^(-1/3)<=3*2^(4/3)<7.560.
new_theorem.key_identity: If N=lambda(cos theta,sin theta)(cos theta,sin theta)^T then det Gamma=s^2 sin^2 theta and |lambda|det Gamma=|det M|.
new_theorem.provenance: The mixed-Fresnel theorem is applied to ORIGINAL independent coordinates; no independence of L,V is asserted.

target_family_paid.definition: Q_eta=eta H^2+2sqrt(1+eta)HL+V^2 on a diffuse Fourier leaf frame

route_obstruction.definition: R_eta=eta H^2+2sqrt(2(1+eta))HL+L^2-V^2 on the same diffuse Fourier frame
facts: natural rank-two mixed-Fresnel augmented Gram Gram(sx,x,y) is singular
every ORIGINAL-coordinate cross block has rank at most two, so e_3(A_IJ^T A_IJ)=0 on every cut
hub-containing physical 3x3 principal determinants are O(m^-2), leaf-only triples are singular
the pinned ruled theorem pays q<=0
the exact endpoint eta=0 is paid by the dependence-safe hub receiver with bound 3*2^(4/3)

next_step: Retain the hub-star phase jointly with the second same-bank leaf curvature and prove a minority/two-sheet estimate uniform as the hub Rayleigh coefficient tends to zero; do not pay a worst conditional projection density or infer post-rotation independence.
